newsitem.title: USA: He-Ro says agreement with Cassini void.
newsitem.headline: He-Ro says agreement with Cassini void.

text.p: He-Ro Group Ltd. said Monday that the original agreement to let fashion designer Oleg Cassini, Oleg Cassini, Inc., and Stonehill Investment Corp purchase a controlling interest in the company has been terminated.
The company would not elaborate on why the original deal fell through, and no officials were available for comment.
He-Ro said it is, however, in negotiations with Cassini and Stonhill to form a new agreement. It added that it is also in talks with other potential investors.

In the original agreement, announced March 12, Cassini and Stonehill would have purchased 80 percent of He-Ro's common stock for $7 million. The company said its stock was listed for trading today on the OTC Bulliten Board under the symbol (HRGR.OB). It was de-listed from the New York Stock Exchange earlier this month.
He-Ro makes and markets ladies evening and special occasion wear under proprietary labels, including Niteline by Della Roufogali, and under the licensed designer label, Black Tie by Oleg Cassini.
